comparison.objective: Select and install the matching driver bit, power-tighten a loose drawer knob, and return the stopped tool.
comparison.physical_skill: Bit-shape selection, hex-bit insertion, powered screw engagement with axial alignment, fastening, and tool placement.
comparison.success_condition: Correct bit stably mounted, at least 1.3 mm powered feed, closed knob passing a 5 N test, then stopped tool released stably in its stand. Numeric rubric is present.
comparison.reason: Tool-bit selection and powered fastening do not test orientation-dependent granular flow, screen bridging, or mass-based separation.
